snippet.title: Armageddonica | Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The world is dead. The war against the Dire Gods has started. What shall be your command, o leader of the Radiant Armada?

Armageddonica is a single-player roguelike ARPG that fuses modern combat with the feel of the classic real-time strategies we grew up loving. Players take control of powerful hero characters called Champions — each with unique skills and abilities — while leading a divine army made up of dozens of distinctive units. You’ll recruit or summon troops at will, upgrade both your heroes and your forces, and adapt your strategy on the fly — all in the epic battle to bring down the Dire Gods!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166960/Armageddonica/

Stay up to date with the development progress: https://x.com/armageddonica
